y9faaday.baseName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Pre-Lit And Decorated Flocked Pop-Up Christmas Tree
y9faaday.variantName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Pre-Lit And Decorated Flocked Pop-Up Christmas Tree
y9faaday.sourceDescription: Create a beautifully finished Christmas display without spending hours assembling, lighting and decorating your tree. The 4ft Pre-lit & Decorated Flocked Pop-up Tree combines snowy foliage, warm white lights and traditional decorations in one clever, easy-to-use design. The rich green foliage is covered with a generous layer of snow-effect flocking, creating the appearance of a freshly snow-covered Christmas tree. It's already decorated with a coordinated selection of red and white baubles and traditional tartan bows, giving you a classic festive look straight out of the box. With 60 warm white LED lights already arranged throughout the foliage, the tree produces a soft and welcoming Christmas glow. The LEDs are static and remain steadily illuminated, perfectly complementing the traditional red, white and snowy colour scheme. Its clever pop-up construction makes setting up your Christmas display quick and straightforward, while the slim 45cm width makes this compact 4ft model particularly well suited to smaller rooms, hallways, offices or anywhere floor space is limited. Simply assemble, position and shape your tree for an impressive pre-lit and pre-decorated Christmas display with a fraction of the usual effort. Product Features • 4ft pre-lit and decorated pop-up Christmas tree • Snow-flocked green foliage • Pre-decorated with red and white baubles • Traditional tartan bows • Pre-lit with 60 warm white LED lights • Static / steady-on illumination • Slim 45cm maximum width • Quick and convenient pop-up design • Compact plastic stand • Ideal for smaller spaces • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

f77s5c3n.baseName: Walplus 150 Warm LED Lights Slim Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
f77s5c3n.variantName: Walplus 150 Warm LED Lights Slim Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
f77s5c3n.sourceDescription: This Slim Christmas Tree with LED Light is a modern seasonal décor piece that seamlessly fits into compact living spaces, bringing festive spirit wherever it's displayed. Accessible and versatile, it's suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, offering a delightful visual appeal through its cone-shaped stature and warm lighting. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this Christmas tree offers a realistic appearance and robust durability, perfect for supporting decorations and lights year after year. Combined with a metal base for added stability, it ensures the tree stands tall and secure without wobbling, enhancing its overall longevity and sturdiness, making it a reliable choice for holiday decorating. Included Components: Equipped with intricate strands of decorative LED string lights, the tree emits a warm white glow, creating a cozy ambiance. These lights are powered via a USB connection, providing versatile power options and making it ideal for various setups whether near a power outlet or connected to portable power banks, ensuring seamless integration into your festive settings. Features /Function /Design: Tailored for modern homes, this tree's slim design is perfect for those seeking a space-efficient solution. Its simple yet elegant construction allows it to fit neatly against walls, corners, or even tabletops, maximizing space while bringing a touch of nature. The modern style harmonizes with a variety of interior décors, enhancing your home's festive presentation. Recommended Uses: Whether displayed in a living room, garden, or terrace, this tree is perfectly suited for creating holiday cheer in any environment. Its elegant lighting effect makes it a superb choice for evening gatherings, fostering a warm and inviting atmosphere for family and guests during the festive season. Care &Maintenance: To protect your decorative investment, place a cover over the tree when not in use to shield it from dust and potential damage. This simple precaution will help maintain the tree's appearance and functionality year after year, ensuring it remains a cherished part of your holiday tradition. Product Specifications Colour: Green PVC and solid pine wood Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 66 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Durable Decorative with pine cones and ornament balls, Lifelike branch tips with frosted snow, Real wood trunk Reusable, Low maintenance, Simple setup 8 Lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash and steady on Number of PVC tips: 291 Number of pine cones: 33 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: Plug Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

r695h0kf.sourceDescription: Forget about spending time decorating your own Christmas wreath this year – we’ve attached a fantastic array of Xmas decorations to this unique festive centrepiece for you! Packed with frosted pinecones, artificial red berries, silver and mint green Christmas baubles, frost-encrusted foliage, and charming tartan bows, it couldn’t be easier to fall in love with this 50cm decorated wreath from Christmas Tree World! Please note: Decorated Mixed Pine garland is not included. At 50cm, this festive wreath is the perfect size for hanging onto front doors and placing over mantelpieces. A sight to behold all in itself, this wreath really doesn’t need anything else to make it magical (although a few extra Christmas LEDs do offer an extra dose of fairy dust!) Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
